title: Epic: Inline Images in Canvas HTML Uploads
org-lms-post-page scans whole buffer for images though it exports a subtree
description: org-lms-collect-local-images and org-lms-upload-org-images now take a SUBTREEP argument (added in org-grading-tz2); announcement and assignment posting pass t. org-lms-post-page and the syllabus updater still scan the whole buffer, so posting one page from a multi-page course file hashes and, on first run, uploads every image in the file. Left at the old default to avoid changing behaviour that the existing live tests 06 and 10 exercise. Decide whether to switch post-page to subtree scope.

title: org-lms-post-assignment: reflection sub-assignment posts parent params and plain-html body
description: In org-lms-post-assignment, the OL_HAS_REFLECTION branch builds reflection-params but then passes assignment-params to org-lms-canvas-request, so the reflection assignment gets the parent assignment's name, description and points. It also exports its description with 'html rather than 'canvas-html, so it bypasses the Canvas link rewriting (and therefore inline image upload) that the parent now gets. It further stores (plist-get response-data :id) -- the parent's id -- into OL_REFLECTION_ID instead of the reflection response's id. Found while wiring image upload into assignment posting (org-grading-tz2); left alone as out of scope.

title: Verify delayed_post_at against live Canvas for withheld announcements
description: Canvas has no draft state for announcements: it ignored published=false on create and returned HTTP 400 to a PUT carrying it (course 35724, topic 3612569, 2026-09-21). org-lms-headline-to-announcement now always sends published=t and maps ORG_LMS_WITHHOLD to delayed_post_at. The offline tests (14/15) cover the params, but the delayed_post_at round trip has NOT been confirmed against live Canvas -- the write was blocked mid-session. Confirm that a PUT with delayed_post_at succeeds and that the announcement shows as scheduled rather than posted.

title: Phase 0: Create test file scaffold for image upload tests
Fix keyword restoration stub in migration rollback
Canvas file upload fails silently in batch Emacs
description: Posting test/demo-assignment.org from batch emacs (test/run-tests.sh -l test/post-demos.el) left .canvas-image-cache.el holding nil: org-lms-collect-local-images found the image, the upload ran, and org-lms-upload-image-if-needed's condition-case swallowed a failure, so the url-map was empty and the exported img src fell back to the bare relative filename. The identical call succeeds from the live Emacs. Suspect the request-based step 1 (org-lms-file-post-request) under --batch. org-lms-upload-image-if-needed should surface the failure rather than returning (nil . cache), and posting should probably refuse to ship a file: link.

title: Phase 5+6: Export integration and full pipeline
org-lms.el calls request without (require 'request)
description: org-lms-canvas-request, org-lms-file-post-request, org-lms-new-quiz-request and org-lms-canvas-inspect all call request, but org-lms.el never requires it -- it works only because the user's init loads the package. Batch runs of the :live-api tests in test/org-lms-image-tests.el fail with (void-function request) for this reason. Found while establishing a batch test baseline for org-grading-tz2.

title: Convert migration polling to async timer-based approach
close_reason: Added async timer-based polling with run-at-time, updated execute to use it

title: Wire inline image upload into announcement and assignment posting
description: org-lms-post-page and the syllabus updater already bind org-canvashtml-image-url-map around their canvas-html export, so local inline images get uploaded to Canvas and the file: link is rewritten to a Canvas preview URL. org-lms-headline-to-announcement and org-lms-post-assignment did not, so images in announcements and assignments shipped as and rendered broken. Bind the map in both, and add a SUBTREEP argument to org-lms-collect-local-images / org-lms-upload-org-images so posting one headline from a multi-headline course file uploads only that subtree's images.
acceptance_criteria: Announcement and assignment descriptions contain the Canvas preview URL, not a file: URL. Covered by org-lms-image-test-11/12/13 (offline, no live API).
